data.gender_notes: Charulatha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Charu means 'radiant', and Latha means 'beauty'. Charulatha is a name inspired by the divine beauty and radiance of various Hindu goddesses. The name Charulatha carries the meaning “Radiant Beauty” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Charulatha usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with grace and beauty, symbolizing inner radiance and outer charm.
data.etymology: Charulatha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant Beauty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Charulatha total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

vedic_reference.note: Charulatha is derived from the Sanskrit words 'charu' meaning grace and 'latha' meaning flow, symbolizing a continuous flow of blessings and grace.

historical_references.reference: Charulatha was the name of the queen of the Chalukya king Vijayaditya (1086-1108 CE). She was known for her beauty and intelligence and played a significant role in expanding the Chalukya empire in the Deccan region of India.

Charulatha was also the name of a famous courtesan who lived during the medieval period in India (13th-15th centuries). She was renowned for her exceptional singing and dancing abilities and was a popular figure in the royal courts of many kings.

modern_usage.modern_context: Charulatha is a popular name in South Indian cinema, with actresses like Revathy Stridhan and Revathy Aravind bearing the name. Charulatha is also a common name in the yoga and wellness community, as it is believed to have a soothing and calming effect. In the digital media space, Charulatha is a popular name for YouTube channels focusing on traditional Indian arts and crafts.
